domain.name: Agent Application Development
domain.scope: Build a small tool-using agent application.

mental_model.summary: A user request reaches an agent, the model decides how to respond, and tools extend the system with external capabilities.

goals.title: Build a tool-using agent
goals.outcome: A working agent can call one external tool and return a final response.
goals.why_it_matters: It demonstrates the core model–tool execution loop.

main_processes.title: Build a tool-using agent
main_processes.outcome: The agent uses the tool when appropriate and returns a response.

stages.title: Prepare the environment
stages.why_it_exists: The application needs its runtime and dependencies.

stages.title: Configure the model
stages.local_goal: Create a model client the application can invoke.
stages.why_it_exists: The agent needs a model to interpret requests and choose actions.

stages.title: Define a tool
stages.local_goal: Create one external capability the agent can call.
stages.why_it_exists: Tools let the system obtain information or perform actions beyond model generation.

example.title: Weather lookup
example.summary: A tool accepts a city and returns weather text.

stages.title: Construct the agent
stages.local_goal: Connect the model and tool into an executable agent.
stages.why_it_exists: The agent coordinates model reasoning and tool access.

stages.title: Run the agent
stages.local_goal: Execute the agent on a user request.
stages.why_it_exists: Execution turns the configured structure into observable behavior.

stages.title: Verify the result
stages.local_goal: Confirm that the tool was used when required and a final answer was produced.
stages.why_it_exists: A runnable program is not enough; the intended process must actually occur.

concepts.name: Model
concepts.definition: The language model used to interpret requests and produce or select actions.

concepts.name: Tool
concepts.definition: An external callable capability available to the agent.
concepts.role: Extends the system beyond model-only generation.

concepts.name: Agent
concepts.definition: The executable coordination layer that handles a request using a model and optional tools.

operations.name: Configure
operations.definition: Provide the settings required for an object to work.

operations.name: Define
operations.definition: Create a usable capability description and implementation.

operations.name: Bind
operations.definition: Associate capabilities into a usable execution unit.
operations.purpose: Connect model and tool to the agent.

operations.name: Invoke
operations.definition: Execute a configured model or agent.

operations.name: Verify
operations.definition: Check that the intended operational behavior occurred.

branches.title: Choose a model provider
branches.description: Different providers can implement the same model-configuration Stage.

branches.title: Add conversation memory
branches.description: Extend the base agent with persisted conversational state.

practices.title: Build a weather lookup agent
instructions: Construct an agent with the model and tool.
Ask a request that requires the tool.
Verify the tool call and final response.
practices.expected_outcome: The agent calls the weather tool and returns a response based on the tool result.
checkpoint_questions: Why is the Tool separate from the Model?
What role does the Agent play between the user request and the Tool?
Where would memory attach if the application needed conversational state?
